facts.fact: Novo Jornal reports that the National Assembly approved the Cybersecurity Bill in general terms on 23 January 2026, 105 for, 1 against and 75 UNITA abstentions.

A UNITA deputy, quoted by Novo Jornal, says Law 7/17 of 16 February (protection of computer networks and systems) is part of the current legal order and the bill would repeal it; the report dates nothing about Law 7/17 beyond its 2017 enactment, so as_of is the report's publication date.
facts.system: Lei n.º 7/17 de Protecção das Redes e Sistemas Informáticos

note: No use of either law is stated.
